title: Making the Club Poster
instructions: Listen to the conversation and answer the questions.
transcript:
Maya: It is nine forty. Are you free for twenty minutes, Leo?
Leo: Yes. I am busy after ten, so I can help now.
Maya: We need a poster for new club members. Is this the same room as our meeting?
Leo: Yes. We can make it here. The desk is by the door.
Maya: The room is dark. Can you turn on the yellow desk lamp, please?
Leo: Sure. Where should I put these pens?
Maya: In the white cup on the desk. Please move the brown chair away from the door so people can come in.
Leo: I found a long ruler. Can I use it to draw a straight line on the poster?
Maya: Yes. Please write "Welcome to our club" above the line.
Leo: What time should we put the poster outside?
Maya: At nine forty-five, next to the door.
Leo: All right. Then I will go to my class at ten.
Maya: Thank you for helping. Good luck with your class!
Leo: Thanks, Maya. See you later!

questions.prompt: How long can Leo help Maya?
questions.evidence:
Are you free for twenty minutes, Leo?
Leo: Yes.
questions.explanation: Maya 问能否帮忙二十分钟，Leo 回答 Yes；十点是他后面忙碌的时间。

questions.prompt: Why does Maya ask Leo to turn on the lamp?
questions.evidence: The room is dark. Can you turn on the yellow desk lamp, please?
questions.explanation: Maya 先说房间很暗，然后请求 Leo 打开灯；其他原因没有出现在这段对话中。

questions.prompt: Where should Leo put the pens?
options: In the white cup on the desk.
answers: In the white cup on the desk.
questions.evidence: In the white cup on the desk.
questions.explanation: Maya 说把笔放进桌上的白色杯子。

questions.prompt: Why does Maya ask Leo to move the chair?
options: To make space for the lamp.
To put the poster on it.
To let Leo sit near the desk.
questions.evidence: Please move the brown chair away from the door so people can come in.
questions.explanation: so 后解释目的：让人们可以进门。

questions.prompt: What does Leo ask to use the long ruler for?
questions.evidence: Can I use it to draw a straight line on the poster?
questions.explanation: it 指刚找到的长尺子；Leo 问能否用它在海报上画直线。

questions.prompt: What should Leo write on the poster?
questions.evidence: Please write "Welcome to our club" above the line.
questions.explanation: Maya 明确要求在横线上方写欢迎加入俱乐部。

questions.prompt: When do they plan to put the poster outside?
questions.evidence: At nine forty-five, next to the door.
questions.explanation: Maya 回答九点四十五，并补充放在门旁。

questions.prompt: Who wishes the other person good luck?
questions.evidence: Maya: Thank you for helping. Good luck with your class!
questions.explanation: 轮次标记显示是 Maya 对 Leo 说 Good luck；Leo 随后表示感谢。
